# Remover Metadados / Metadata Remover

Maintained by Modern X Webs. Contact: dev@modernxwebs.com.

The application reads and processes selected file contents in the browser,
without uploading them for processing. Website delivery and external resource
connections are separate from file processing. Local processing is not anonymous
browsing or a guarantee of complete metadata removal.

## Coverage

- JPEG, WebP and AVIF use re-encoding; pixels and color/profile information can change.
- PNG normally strips selected chunks while preserving compressed image data.
- HEIC/HEIF becomes JPEG. GIF/BMP/TIFF normally become a single-frame/page PNG.
- SVG processing removes selected elements; it is not a complete sanitizer.
- PDF processing clears standard properties and detaches selected references.
  Custom properties, detached bytes, annotations, attachments and visible content can remain.
- Office/OpenDocument processing clears selected package properties and thumbnails.
  Comments, tracked changes and embedded files can remain.
- MP3 and MP4/MOV/M4V processing targets selected tag envelopes or container boxes.
  Complete metadata removal and real-media playback are not established.

## Privacy

Processing libraries are delivered with the website; there are no remote CDN
script fallbacks. Google Fonts and directory/Product Hunt badge images create
external connections. Google Analytics is optional and disabled in an unconfigured
source build; when configured, it loads only on its configured production hostname.
Application file events use permitted format labels, counts, sizes and fixed error
codes, not selected filenames, metadata values or raw errors.

GPS coordinates are displayed locally. Opening or loading an external map sends
the selected coordinates and connection information to that provider only after
the user chooses the map action. Map permission resets when the file changes.

Dropping files on informational pages temporarily stores them in browser IndexedDB
to transfer them to the removal tool. The next tool visit consumes or clears the
entry. Interrupted transfers can remain until a later tool visit or until browser
site data is cleared. Reports and downloaded files remain where the user saves them.

## Evidence

The verification pages describe coverage and remaining limitations. The JSON report
contains maintainer-run fixture results, environment versions and an engine hash.
These are not an independent security audit or proof for every file or browser.
No universal C2PA, AI-provenance, watermark, steganography or anonymization guarantee
is made. Keep originals and review the downloaded copy before sharing it.
